policy: A listed base model has a reviewed hosted zero-cost route. Leaderboard reasoning-effort variants are included by assumption, not verified as available on that route. Different model releases and specialized variants are not treated as interchangeable. Unknown is not paid; open weights alone do not qualify. Free quotas and availability can change.
